description_en: Verifies a digital signature by using the public key of an asymmetric CMK
description_zh: 使用非对称密钥进行验签
name: AsymmetricVerify

parameters.help_en:
The globally unique identifier (GUID) of the customer master key (CMK).

You can also specify the alias that is bound to the CMK. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68522.html
parameters.help_zh:
主密钥（CMK）的全局唯一标识符。

该参数也可以被指定为主密钥绑定的别名。更多信息，请参加见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/68522.html
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the key version. The ID must be the GUID of the key version
parameters.help_zh: 密钥版本ID。密钥版本的全局唯一标识符
parameters.name: key_version_id

parameters.help_en:
The digest that is generated using the hash algorithm that corresponds to the value of Algorithm to hash the original message.

The value is Base64-encoded
parameters.help_zh:
使用Algorithm中对应的哈希算法，对原始消息生成的摘要。

使用Base64编码
parameters.name: digest

parameters.help_en:
The signature value to be verified.

The value is Base64-encoded
parameters.help_zh:
待验证的签名值。

使用Base64编码
parameters.name: value

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run.

true: performs a dry run.

false (default): does not perform a dry run.

A dry run is used to test API calls and verify whether you have the permissions to access the specified resources and whether the request parameters are valid. If you perform a dry run, KMS always returns a failure response that indicates the cause of the failure. The following failure causes are included:

DryRunOperationError: The request would have succeeded if the DryRun parameter is not specified.

ValidationError: The specified parameters in the request are invalid.

AccessDeniedError: You are not authorized to perform this operation on the KMS resource
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启DryRun模式。

true：开启
false（默认值）：关闭

DryRun模式用于测试API调用，验证您是否具有相应资源的权限，以及请求参数是否配置正确。DryRun模式开启后，KMS会始终返回失败并提示失败原因。失败原因包含如下：

DryRunOperationError：不配置DryRun参数时，请求会成功。
ValidationError：请求中指定的参数有误。
AccessDeniedError：您无权在KMS资源上执行该操作
parameters.name: dry_run

KeyId.description_en:
The GUID of the CMK.

If you use an alias of the CMK in the request, the ID of the CMK is returned
KeyId.description_zh:
主密钥的全局唯一标识符。

如果请求中的KeyId参数使用的是主密钥的别名，在响应中会返回别名对应的主密钥标识符

KeyVersionId.description_en: The ID of the key version that is used for signature verification
KeyVersionId.description_zh: 对明文数据进行加密的主密钥版本号

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Value.description_en: Indicates whether the signature is valid
